meta.title: Order Activity records a vendor revising a bid
gaps: The exact vendor identity recorded for the revision
That all earlier activity entries are present and none are missing
That activity entries are ordered chronologically
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The exact vendor identity recorded for the revision; The revision's date and time; That all earlier activity entries are present and none are missing; That activity entries are ordered chronologically

steps.note: Start a buyer-side event for the bid revision flow.
Use an RFQ stage so the vendor can submit and revise a bid.
Apply the first available pricing template.
Add a product for the vendor's quote.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor to submit the bid.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Have the first QA vendor submit the initial bid.
Confirm the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Have the same vendor revise the bid, which is the behavior under test.
Confirm the revised bid was accepted.
Open the RFQ stage's Order Activity drawer.
Confirm the Order Activity drawer is visible.
Check that the activity content contains a bid-revision entry.
